svg.aria-label: Terminal capture: sync-to-global.sh dry run, then --apply, then verify-sync.sh, run against a throwaway HOME
svg.title: Terminal capture: cross-tool sync into a throwaway HOME
svg.desc: Output of `bash scripts/sync-to-global.sh`, `bash scripts/sync-to-global.sh --apply` and `bash scripts/verify-sync.sh`, captured on 2026-08-20 with HOME pointed at a throwaway directory so the capture touched no real tool config. Verbatim except for two declared prefix swaps (the sandbox HOME reads ~, this clone reads <repo>) and the marked elision rows, each of which states how many lines it replaces. Final result: 108 entries verified, 0 drift, exit 0.
svg.text: Real output, captured in a throwaway HOME
2026-08-20 · macOS 26.5.1 · HOME pointed at a scratch directory, so no real tool config was touched.
Verbatim stdout+stderr, with two declared swaps: the sandbox HOME renders as ~, this clone's path as <repo>.
row numbers are drawn by this figure, not by the shell
... 103 lines elided by this figure — 10 more commands/, 28 templates/, 65 scripts/
... 14 lines elided by this figure — audit … unify-surfaces
... 14 lines elided by this figure — the other 14 commands
... 14 lines elided by this figure — the other 14 commands
... 14 lines elided by this figure — the other 14 commands
... 14 lines elided by this figure — the other 14 skills
DRY RUN — re-run with --apply to perform the actions above.
... 198 lines elided by this figure — same listing; link / skill / cmd / toml replace would
Elision rows are figure chrome; each says exactly how many output lines it replaces. Nothing else is altered.
Dry run is the default and writes no links — but it does mkdir -p the destination directories, so it is not a strict no-op.
--apply is shown because verify-sync.sh has nothing to verify until the links exist. Exit codes recorded by the harness: 0 · 0 · 0.
verify-sync.sh checks the Claude Code symlink lane only — its 108 entries are the commands/, templates/ and scripts/ children.
The five copy-based tools get a leakage check from verify-global-scope.sh; nothing re-verifies their content is current.
